parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or synchronization instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** or DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: PrecheckItems
parameters.description:
The precheck items to skip. Separate multiple items with commas (,). Valid values:

- **CHECK_SAME_OBJ**: checks whether objects with the same name exist.
- **CHECK_SAME_USER**: checks whether accounts with different names exist.
- **CHECK_SRC**: checks the source database version.
- **CHECK_TOPOLOGY**: checks the topology version.
> For the topology versions supported by DTS, see [Topology overview](~~124115~~).
- **CHECK_SERVER_ID**: checks the server_id of the source database.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
